Name: Fellowship of the Pets
Author: war77
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1787076248-1503354274.png[/img]

Enhances the Pet experience, making pets able to learn skills as well as improving their AI(Any pet).

[b][color=#00ff00][font=Comic Sans MS][i]FOTP 3.0 is based on Pets Enhanced – A Pet Mechanic Overhaul, originally created by SunkenLace.[/i][/font][/color][/b]
[color=#00ff00][font=Comic Sans MS][i]
After development of Pets Enhanced ended, its source code was made available under the MIT License. FOTP 3.0 uses that source as its foundation so these pet systems can continue to work with modern Stardew Valley and SMAPI, while adding and expanding the Fellowship of the Pets features.[/i][/font][/color]
[color=#00ff00][font=Comic Sans MS][i]
Huge credit to [b]SunkenLace[/b] for creating Pets Enhanced and for making the source available to the community. Without her original work, the systems and artwork contained in FOTP 3.0 would not exist.[/i][/font][/color]

New additions:
- Pet UI and Status Window (gamepad compatible).
- New Mechanics for pets.
- Pet inventory upgrades and collars which provide buffs.
- Makes simple the process of putting and taking off hats .

[b]What's new?[/b]
- New items sold at [b]Marnie's Shop[/b]:
﻿- A Pet Manual(Non-consumable)      [ Price: 7000g ]
﻿- Dog Treats(Consumable)                  [ Price: 30g ]
﻿- Cat Treats(Consumable)                   [ Price: 30g ]
﻿﻿- Crunchy Treats(Consumable)                   [ Price: 30g ]
﻿- Pet Backpack(Consumable)              [ Price: 3000g ]

- [b]Pet Flute [/b]added!
Spoiler:  
Show

- New Trick Learning Mechanic for Pets(Cats and Dogs):
Spoiler:  
Show

- Mechanic: [b]Follow[/b]
Your pet will follow you anywhere (except at events, cuz they're player-exclusive).
﻿(You can have up to 3 pets following you at the same time)

- Mechanic: [b]Hunt[/b]
Your pet will follow you and attack any monster they deem "Huntable".
﻿Pet damage scales with its hunting skill mastery and base stats.

- ([b]Dog Only[/b])Mechanic: [b]Forage[/b]
Your pet will follow you and search in any nearby bushes for forage.

- ([b]Cat Only[/b])Mechanic: [b]Fishing[/b]
Your pet will go to the nearest water source and fish once it sees viable fishing spot (bubbles on water), then it will pick up the fish if it fits into its inventory.

- Mechanic: [b]Wait[/b]
Your pet will sit down and wait for you on the spot until you tell it to stop.
﻿The pet will also passively recover its energy as time passes.

- Now you can [b]gift[/b] "treats" to your pets to increase their [b]friendship[/b] more quickly or to replenish their energy bar.
    Upon giving a treat to a pet, the item will appear inside the Diet List Scroll (Gift icon inside the Status Window); There you can see some simplified information about the item.

- Your pet will increase their mastery over a skill the more it performs it. Higher mastery means unlocking skill perks (which provides various benefits).

- You can obtain [b]Pet Collars[/b] (which provides different buffs) by leveling up your farmer skills (you'll receive the recipe via mail or in Marnie's shop once you fulfill the unlock conditions).

Buffs added by Pet Collars:
[list]
[*]Rough collar: +25% attack buff +10% crit chance (Single pet)[/*]
[*]Lightweight collar: +4% speed buff (player) -15% attack cooldown (Single pet, combat).[/*]
[*]Luxury collar:  25% chance to re-roll product quality chances (All pets, fishing, foraging). 10% chance to get double loot when foraging or fishing (All pets).[/*]
[*]Flowery collar: +15% chance to find products when foraging (Single pet). +10% chance to get quality products when foraging (Single pet). Greatly reduces chances to get trash (single pet).[/*]
[*]Seagoing collar: +20% chance to find products when fishing (Single pet). Increases chances of getting better fish (Single pet), greatly reduces chances to get trash (Single pet).[/*]
[/list]﻿
[b]Installation Instructions
[/b]- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ along with its requirements.
- Extract this mod into your mod folder. Usually at [i]..[/i][i]\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods.
[/i]- Enjoy!
